integrity: The mixed discovery-probability/entropy moment is reconstructed from explicit Beta(1,theta) size-biased integrals and telescoped exactly. A standalone deterministic checker compares beta-integral, finite-sum, digamma, and trigamma formulations and checks the stated asymptotics. Finite numerical checks are supplementary rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to PD(0,theta), not positive-discount Pitman–Yor laws.
It is a prior-predictive covariance, not a posterior covariance conditional on observed counts.
An equivalent older identity under different species-richness terminology remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Dirichlet-process sample richness has an exact saturating covariance with latent Shannon entropy
